key: Battery/background start was denied. Open once so the plugin can run with Torque.
source: Battery/background start was denied. Open once so the plugin can run with Torque.
text: Ukuqala ngebhethri noma ngemuva kunqatshiwe. Vula kanye ukuze i-plugin isebenze ne-Torque.

key: Add additional tanks as needed (stock tank 1 always stays). Do not switch senders onto the PCM FLI pin (false fill). Each extra tank needs its own Torque extra PID (MCU Mode 22, unique name — not 012F or Ford 16C1). Select-PID value is the 1-based tank id. Gal/hr is charged only to the active tank.
source: Add additional tanks as needed (stock tank 1 always stays). Do not switch senders onto the PCM FLI pin (false fill). Each extra tank needs its own Torque extra PID (MCU Mode 22, unique name — not 012F or Ford 16C1). Select-PID value is the 1-based tank id. Gal/hr is charged only to the active tank.
text: Engeza amathangi angaphezulu njengoba kudingeka (ithangi lefemula 1 lihlala njalo). Ungashintshi abathumeli baye kuphini ye-PCM FLI (ukugcwalisa okungamanga). Ithangi ngalinye elingeziwe lidinga i-PID eyengeziwe ye-Torque yalo (MCU Mode 22, igama eliyingqayizivele — hhayi i-012F noma i-Ford 16C1). Inani le-Select-PID yi-id yethangi eqala ku-1. I-Gal/hr ikhokhiswa ethangini elisebenzayo kuphela.

key: Writes a value onto Torque's stock Fuel Level (012F) so existing gauges show it: Off, Smoothed, or Corrected from the Chunk, Band or Kalman fit. A fit that is not built yet writes the smoothed level.
source: Writes a value onto Torque's stock Fuel Level (012F) so existing gauges show it: Off, Smoothed, or Corrected from the Chunk, Band or Kalman fit. A fit that is not built yet writes the smoothed level.
text: Ibhala inani ku-Fuel Level yefemula ye-Torque (012F) ukuze amagedi akhona akubonise: Valiwe, bushelelezi, noma kulungisiwe kusuka ku-Chunk, Band noma Kalman fit. I-fit engakakhiwa ibhala izinga elibushelelezi.

key: Requires Torque Pro (paid). Torque Lite does not support plugins.
source: Requires Torque Pro (paid). Torque Lite does not support plugins.
text: Kudingeka i-Torque Pro (ekhokhelwayo). I-Torque Lite ayisekeli ama-plugin.

source: The name of this vehicle profile. Each Torque vehicle profile gets its own plugin profile, data and learned maps.

key: Where the raw fuel level comes from. Detect (needs the ECU connected) tries the candidates read-only and asks you to confirm unless two sources agree. Confirm is on the setup page and in the notification. None = detect on the next connect.
source: Where the raw fuel level comes from. Detect (needs the ECU connected) tries the candidates read-only and asks you to confirm unless two sources agree. Confirm is on the setup page and in the notification. None = detect on the next connect.
text: Izinga elingahluziwe likaphethiloli livela kuphi. Thola (i-ECU kumele ixhunyiwe) ifunda abangenele kuphela futhi icela ukuqinisekisa ngaphandle uma imithombo emibili ivumelana. U-Qinisekisa usekhasini lokusetha nasesazisweni. Akukho = thola ekuxhumaneni okulandelayo.

key:
Quick start
 1. Install Torque Pro (the paid version; Torque Lite does not support plugins) and pair your OBD-II adapter.
 2. Enable this plugin in Torque → Settings → Plugins.
 3. Allow notifications, and set battery use to Unrestricted so Torque can start this plugin in the background.
 4. In Torque, select the vehicle profile for the car you are driving. Data is kept per Torque profile and checked against the vehicle's VIN/ECU identity.
 5. On a new profile the fuel source is detected when you connect; if asked, compare it with your dash gauge and tap Confirm. Confirm is on the setup page and in the notification. You can also pick it below.
 6. There is no tank size to enter here. Each fit learns its own size, shown under Learned tank size; until then its corrected percent reads 1:1 with the gauge. Enter your tank size in the Torque vehicle profile for Torque's own remaining fuel and DTE.
 7. In Torque, add gauges for [FuelSmooth] Smoothed Fuel Level and each fit's Corrected % and Tank size. The plugin does not publish remaining fuel or DTE. A notice during a refit says that fit reads 1:1 until its refit finishes.
 8. Feed fuel level back to Torque: Off, Smoothed, or Corrected from the Chunk, Band or Kalman fit onto your 012F gauge. Torque's own fuel remaining and DTE then use that level with the tank size and long-term mpg in the Torque profile.
 9. Fuel is counted only while the engine runs. The plugin runs only while Torque is connected to the ECU.
 10. Keep driving and filling up; accuracy builds over several partial tanks. If the plugin cannot tell which vehicle this is, it asks in a notification and on this page; choose what to do with that drive.
 11. All data stays on this phone. No GPS or location is recorded.
source:
Quick start
 1. Install Torque Pro (the paid version; Torque Lite does not support plugins) and pair your OBD-II adapter.
 2. Enable this plugin in Torque → Settings → Plugins.
 3. Allow notifications, and set battery use to Unrestricted so Torque can start this plugin in the background.
 4. In Torque, select the vehicle profile for the car you are driving. Data is kept per Torque profile and checked against the vehicle's VIN/ECU identity.
 5. On a new profile the fuel source is detected when you connect; if asked, compare it with your dash gauge and tap Confirm. Confirm is on the setup page and in the notification. You can also pick it below.
 6. There is no tank size to enter here. Each fit learns its own size, shown under Learned tank size; until then its corrected percent reads 1:1 with the gauge. Enter your tank size in the Torque vehicle profile for Torque's own remaining fuel and DTE.
 7. In Torque, add gauges for [FuelSmooth] Smoothed Fuel Level and each fit's Corrected % and Tank size. The plugin does not publish remaining fuel or DTE. A notice during a refit says that fit reads 1:1 until its refit finishes.
 8. Feed fuel level back to Torque: Off, Smoothed, or Corrected from the Chunk, Band or Kalman fit onto your 012F gauge. Torque's own fuel remaining and DTE then use that level with the tank size and long-term mpg in the Torque profile.
 9. Fuel is counted only while the engine runs. The plugin runs only while Torque is connected to the ECU.
 10. Keep driving and filling up; accuracy builds over several partial tanks. If the plugin cannot tell which vehicle this is, it asks in a notification and on this page; choose what to do with that drive.
 11. All data stays on this phone. No GPS or location is recorded.
text:
Ukuqala okusheshayo
 1. Faka i-Torque Pro (inguqulo ekhokhelwayo; i-Torque Lite ayisekeli ama-plugin) bese ubhangqa i-adaptha ye-OBD-II.
 2. Vula le plugin ku-Torque → Izilungiselelo → Plugins.
 3. Vumela izaziso, bese usetha ukusetshenziswa kwebhethri kube Okungenamkhawulo ukuze i-Torque iqale le plugin ngemuva.
 4. Ku-Torque, khetha iphrofayela yemoto oyishayelayo. Idatha igcinwa ngephrofayela ngayinye ye-Torque futhi ihlolwa nobunikazi be-VIN/ECU yemoto.
 5. Kuphrofayela entsha umthombo kaphethiloli utholwa uma uxhuma; uma ubuzwa, uqhathanise negedi yedeshboard bese uthinta Qinisekisa. U-Qinisekisa usekhasini lokusetha nasesazisweni. Ungakhetha nangezansi.
 6. Akukho bukhulu bethangi obuzofakwa lapha. Ukulinganisa ngakunye kufunda ubukhulu bako, okuboniswa ngaphansi koBukhulu bethangi obufundiwe; kuze kube yileso sikhathi iphesenti elilungisiwe lifunda u-1:1 nemitha. Faka ubukhulu bethangi kuphrofayela yemoto ye-Torque ukuze kusetshenziswe uphethiloli osele ne-DTE ye-Torque uqobo.
 7. Ku-Torque, engeza amamitha e-[FuelSmooth] Smoothed Fuel Level kanye, kokulinganisa ngakunye, ne-Corrected % kanye ne-Tank size. I-plugin ayishicileli uphethiloli osele noma i-DTE. Isaziso ngesikhathi sokulinganisa kabusha sithi lokho kulinganisa kufunda u-1:1 kuze kuphele ukulinganisa kabusha.
 8. Buyisela izinga likaphethiloli ku-Torque: Valiwe, bushelelezi, noma kulungiswe ukusuka ekulinganiseni kwe-Chunk, Band noma Kalman, kumitha yakho ye-012F. Uphethiloli osele ne-DTE ye-Torque uqobo basebenzisa lelo zinga kanye nobukhulu bethangi kanye ne-mpg yesikhathi eside kuphrofayela ye-Torque.
 9. Uphethiloli ubalwa kuphela ngenkathi injini isebenza. I-plugin isebenza kuphela ngenkathi i-Torque ixhunywe ku-ECU.
 10. Qhubeka ushayela uze ugcwalise; ukunemba kukhula emathanqini amaningana angagcwele. Uma i-plugin ingakwazi ukusho ukuthi le yimuphi umoto, ibuza esazisweni nakuleli khasi; khetha ukuthi kwenzekani ngaleyo ndlela.
 11. Yonke idatha ihlala kule foni. Akukho GPS noma indawo eqoshiwayo.
